chroot_path.description: Absolute path to the root directory for all SFTP users (chroot jail).

enable_acl.description: Enable support for file/directory ACLs (required for fine-grained permissions).

umask.description: Default umask for uploaded files (octal format).

max_sessions.description: Maximum number of concurrent SFTP sessions allowed.

log_path.description: Path to log file (leave empty to use syslog).

listen_address.description: IP address or hostname the server will bind to. Use '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces.

port.description: TCP port for SFTP connections (must be >1024 for non-root users).

use_pam.description: Enable PAM authentication (required to authenticate system users).

use_tls.description: Enable TLS/SSL encryption for SFTP (requires valid cert/key paths).

tls_cert_file.description: Path to TLS certificate file (PEM format).

tls_key_file.description: Path to TLS private key file (PEM format).

virtual_users.description: List of virtual (non-system) users with custom SFTP access rules.

password_hash.description: Password hash (e.g., {SHA512}xxxxx or {CRYPT}xxxxx). Leave empty to disable login.

permissions.description: Permissions string: R (read), W (write), M (modify), D (delete), L (list), A (all).

max_upload_size.description: Maximum upload size (MB) per session. 0 = unlimited.

ip_whitelist.description: List of allowed IP addresses or CIDR blocks. Leave empty to allow all.

directory_acls.description: List of directory-specific ACL rules for fine-grained access control.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the rule.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the directory (relative to chroot if no leading slash).

permissions.description: Permissions: R, W, M, D, L. Omit for no access.

inherit.description: Whether this ACL inherits permissions from parent directory.
